shortDescription: India's wholesale prices (INWPI=ECI) rose 9.92% year-on-year in August after a 9.78% rise in the previous month, government data showed on Monday.Economists polled by Reuters had projected wholesale prices to rise 9.89% year-on-year.

children: India's wholesale prices (INWPI=ECI) rose 9.92% year-on-year in August after a 9.78% rise in the previous month, government data showed on Monday.
Economists polled by Reuters had projected wholesale prices to rise 9.89% year-on-year.
